projects.name: Evaluating Long Range (LoRa) units for remote robot control
projects.description: Measure range, latency and link reliability for low-bandwidth robot commands in field conditions, and identify where LoRa fits in the control system.

projects.name: High-altitude small-object sheep detection
projects.description: Assess how flight altitude affects the reliable detection of small sheep in aerial imagery, informing practical capture and vision-system requirements.

projects.name: Testing RF impacts across heterogeneous agricultural obstacles
projects.description: Investigate how vegetation, fencing and farm structures affect radio propagation, with the goal of making field robot links more predictable.

projects.name: Sheep synthetic-data generation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)
projects.description: Explore adapting image-generation models to create varied synthetic sheep imagery that can expand and diversify detector-training data.

projects.name: Live sheep clustering and map visualisation
projects.description: Added real-time sheep clusters, trail history and interactive map overlays to make flock observations easier to interpret.

projects.name: Guidance for ethical robotics around animals
projects.description: Develop a practical whitepaper outlining considerations for the design, evaluation and responsible use of robots around animals. Bring together evidence and perspectives on animal welfare, human oversight, regulation and stakeholder responsibilities.
